id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1888: "The sacred ember holds our god's power. With it, you can read the great tree's memories from saplings on the surface.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19b4: "Many Skyfolk know the surface well. Ask the villagers where the three saplings are said to be.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b04: "I once heard from Igortap that a mystic gear can open the door of the Tower of Oblivion, which keeps time.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c10: "The tower in the mural should stand north of Yggdrasil, ringed by mountains. Ride Cetacea there.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d6c: "Cetacea, the divine messenger, seems to have awakened to new power. Its wings will guide you.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e30: "You have nothing left to fear. Ride Cetacea to the black sun and defeat the evil god Calasmos.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fac: "The saplings know everything... Koron seems to know what that means.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2044: "Koron is waiting for you, Luminary, at the Temple of the Sun on the village's central floating island.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2134: "They say sacred saplings grow at high altitude. To find one, ride the whale around the world.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2270: "My clan has long tended the sacred saplings.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22fc: "Tending the holy tree that conveys the great tree's will is a heavy duty, but I'm proud of it.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2454: "I had a strange dream. The Skyfolk village was attacked by monsters, and only I survived in the Temple of the Sun.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2568: "Alone, I met you, Luminary, in the temple...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25f4: "Why did a Luminary whose face I've never seen appear in my dream? ...A truly strange dream.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2794: "Welcome, Luminary. This is the village of the Skyfolk, a clan that has served Yggdrasil since ancient times.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a60: "Welcome, Luminary. This is the village of the Skyfolk, a clan that has served Yggdrasil since ancient times.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c84: "Welcome, Luminary. This is the village of the Skyfolk, a clan that has served Yggdrasil since ancient times.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ddc: "Welcome, Luminary. This is the village of the Skyfolk, a clan that has served Yggdrasil since ancient times.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2884: "As a clan who has watched over Erdrea from the heavens for ages, we have something to tell you.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|293c: "First, speak with the Elder. He is on the island with the great statue at the village's far end.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b58: "Are you looking for the Temple of the Sun? It's on the central floating island, straight ahead.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ecc: "...A tower where Senya is? Come to think of it, a strange tower is painted in the mural in the Elder's plaza.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fa0: "Why not ask the Elder? He sleeps now, but he may wake when the Luminary comes.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3158: "What's up, pal? ...Ha, you want to know how to reach the other islands. I'll show you.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|320c: "We use levitation stones to move between islands. Just step on the stone at an island's edge and it moves on its own.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|334c: "By the way, the Elder's island is reached by the levitation stone at the back of this island. Remember that!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34a8: "Come to think of it, when I went down to the surface, I saw a tree just like the sacred sapling at the Temple of the Sun.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3578: "It was near the entrance of Angri-La, where many ascetics gather.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3628: "If you want to go there, using Zoom may be faster than riding Cetacea.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3720: "Did you know, pal? The levitation stones here run on ancient technology that's now lost.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3808: "Some towers on the surface still have things running on the same principle.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3954: "Deep inside this Temple of the Sun rests the sacred divine flame, which has lit the world since its birth.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b78: "Deep inside this Temple of the Sun rests the sacred divine flame, which has lit the world since its birth.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d80: "Deep inside this Temple of the Sun rests the sacred divine flame, which has lit the world since its birth.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a48: "But you can't enter now. It's sacred to us, so the doors stay closed except on special occasions.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c6c: "The time has come for the temple doors to open. Go on, Luminary. Koron awaits you inside.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e74: "Luminary, you've obtained the sacred ember. The flame that lit the world will warm your path too.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4028: "Welcome, Luminary. It's a great honor to meet you, spoken of in legend.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4230: "Welcome, Luminary. It's a great honor to meet you, spoken of in legend.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40ec: "The Elder waits for you not at the Temple of the Sun but on a floating island in the village's depths. Please go to him.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42f4: "I feel the divine flame in the Temple of the Sun calling you. Please go inside.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4414: "I sense new power in you all. Igortap must have awakened your dormant potential.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44ec: "That power will surely help in the fight against the evil god. I pray for your success, Luminary.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|469c: "Inori-nori, sasageru, sasageru! Megurin, megurin, megurinpa! Kanshashan, kanshashan!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f10: "Inori-nori, sasageru, sasageru! Megurin, megurin, megurinpa! Kanshashan, kanshashan!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|47e0: "Nonare, nonare, genkyuto! Genkyuwit, genkyufit! Toryuzo, toryuzo, genkyuwin!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|51e4: "Nonare, nonare, genkyuto! Genkyuwit, genkyufit! Toryuzo, toryuzo, genkyuwin!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|492c: "Since the evil god appeared, I feel the great tree weakening day by day. It's in danger like this.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a14: "You should pray harder too. If our prayers reach it, the great tree will recover a little.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b40: "Nyuzepa, nyuzepa, nyutorin! Jashishan, shanjashi, taoseru! Yushari, kashicha, ganbaripa!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|55b0: "Nyuzepa, nyuzepa, nyutorin! Jashishan, shanjashi, taoseru! Yushari, kashicha, ganbaripa!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c90: "Listen. Even now, the Luminary is risking his life fighting terrifying monsters.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d48: "We can't sit still either. Let's pray with all our might so the Luminary beats the evil god.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f94: "...Huh, what does it mean? It's old Skyfolk language: great tree, we thank you for your blessings.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5084: "Yggdrasil is our precious god, so I pray in thanks with Mom every day.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5270: "...Huh, what does it mean? It's old Skyfolk language: great tree, please get well.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5354: "Since the evil god appeared, the great tree weakens day by day, so I pray with Mom like this.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|546c: "Okay, Mom. I'll pray hard and bring the great tree back to health.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5640: "...Huh, what does it mean? It's old Skyfolk language: Luminary, do your best and defeat the evil god.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5730: "I'm praying with Mom so the Luminary can beat the evil god. Do your best, Luminary!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5834: "Okay, Mom. I'll pray hard so the Luminary can beat the evil god.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|59c0: "I sense evil power above Gallopolis. Is this the great calamity said to have descended from the heavens in ancient times...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ab4: "If left alone, the world will soon walk the path to ruin. What can we do...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5bb8: "A Skyfolk who once went to the surface told me a sapling grew in Dahara Marsh.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5c94: "But it's on a sheer cliff no one can reach on foot, so you'd better ride Cetacea.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5d9c: "The evil god's power keeps growing. If left alone, the world will soon perish.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e64: "Luminary, little time remains. Defeat the evil god quickly and bring peace to the world.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6010: "I've dangled my line for ages to catch sky fish that swim through the clouds, but they won't bite, boo hoo...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6204: "I've dangled my line for ages to catch sky fish that swim through the clouds, but they won't bite, boo hoo...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|60e4: "Never mind that, Luminary. The Elder awaits on the floating island across that levitation stone.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|62d8: "Never mind that, Luminary. Koron awaits at the Temple of the Sun over there.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|63c4: "Sky fish swim in the clouds, and I love them, but they're hard to catch.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|648c: "Their fluffy flesh is superb. No matter how long it takes, I'll catch one!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|65a8: "Hey, Luminary, listen. I was fishing the other day when Cetacea mistakenly bit my bait.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6668: "I almost got dragged down to the surface, body and all. It was truly scary...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|67b8: "Oh my, a human in the Skyfolk village is rare. Did you ride Cetacea here?
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6860: "Hardly anyone from other races comes here, so you're welcome. Take your time.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6990: "When I went down to the surface the other day, I saw a tree of strange shape.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a20: "It was in Bandelphon, where the ruins of a once-prosperous kingdom remain...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ac0: "But it's ringed by cliffs and reachable only on Cetacea, so be careful.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c34: "The Skyfolk are the oldest race, watching over Erdrea since the world's birth.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e58: "The Skyfolk are the oldest race, watching over Erdrea since the world's birth.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ce0: "Humans seem to have forgotten, but long ago Skyfolk and humans mingled often, traveling between surface and sky.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f04: "Long before Erdwin's time, they say we came to this world following our lord, the sacred dragon.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7034: "Cetacea visits this village now and then. It flies the sky booming loudly, and the Skyfolk like it.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7124: "It always looks spaced out, but it's lived since Erdwin's time, so maybe it knows a lot.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|72f0: "I knew it. A human in this village is rare. Decades, centuries... maybe more.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|73a8: "The air is thin here, so humans may find it unfamiliar, but please take your time.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7984: "The air is thin here, so humans may find it unfamiliar, but please take your time.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|74bc: "Oh, so I was mistaken. But you're quite slim and tall for Skyfolk.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7570: "Young Skyfolk these days have gotten such good figures.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76cc: "I knew it. If you've come, the time for the final battle with the evil god has come at last.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7784: "The Skyfolk serve Yggdrasil. We'll help you defeat the evil god. Ask for anything.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|78e0: "Oh, so I was mistaken. Still, a human in this village is rare indeed.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b10: "Welcome, Luminary {var:1} and companions. The Elder is in the plaza ahead.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7bc8: "Many Skyfolk have gathered to welcome you, so please show your face soon.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7cc4: "Koron hurried to the Temple of the Sun. He seems to have a hunch.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d78: "Wise Koron will surely tell you something useful, Luminary.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e88: "...Ah, how beautiful. I lose track of time gazing at it.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ef4: "Oh, Luminary, I've never been to the surface. Going someday is my dream.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7fcc: "The village is comfortable, but small, with limited experiences. I want to see the wider world on the surface.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|816c: "Hup! Hup! I'm the Elder's bodyguard! Anyone rude to the Elder answers to me!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8288: "I was lonely. I didn't fit in with monsters, and humans feared me as a scary monster.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8334: "Only the Elder was different. He wasn't afraid of me and raised me as an adopted son.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|83d4: "To repay him, I became his bodyguard! No matter what, I'll protect him! Hup! Hup! Hyah! Hyah!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|84e4: "Luminary, are you afraid to fight the evil god?
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8574: "I see. No shame in that. Facing such a mighty foe, even a Luminary would feel fear.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|865c: "But you're the man the Elder believed in. Trust yourself and you'll win. I'm cheering! Hup! Hup!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|87a8: "What?! No fear before such a mighty foe? As expected of the legendary Luminary!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8870: "You're the man the Elder believed in. Believe in yourself and no foe can beat you. I'm cheering! Hup! Hup!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8a24: "Thump! Thump! Where's the bad guy?! I show no mercy to anyone who defies the Elder!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8b2c: "I once broke my mallet. A mallet is dearer than life to my clan, so I was crushed.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8c18: "But then the Elder silently fixed it for me. And it came back better than before!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8d04: "No one is kinder! No matter what, I'll protect him! Thump! Thump! Thump-thump!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8e08: "I may look like a monster, but my heart is that of a brave Skyfolk warrior!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8eb4: "Leave the village's defense to us, and fight the evil god without worry! Thump! Thump! Thump-thump!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|903c: "Since the evil god revived, evil monsters from ancient times have appeared on the surface, awakened by their master.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9160: "Because of that, incidents occur everywhere and people on the surface suffer.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9214: "{var:1}... travel the world and help those who suffer. Only you can do it.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|937c: "Skyfolk and humans have long been apart, so you must have been shocked to see Skyfolk for the first time.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9450: "But though our forms differ, we all live by Yggdrasil's blessing and are living beings alike.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9530: "We'll cooperate wholeheartedly to defeat the evil god, enemy of all life.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9638: "We are a clan of the divine who serve the sacred dragon. We once had great magic and fought bravely against the evil god.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9764: "But the endless flow of time stole our power to fight. Now we can only rely on you.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|98f4: "In ancient times, Erdrea fell into peril from the evil god Calasmos's onslaught.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|99ac: "But Erdwin the Luminary, sent by Yggdrasil, and three companions bravely fought the evil god and his monsters.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9ab8: "The four joined forces, forged the Luminary's sword, and after a long battle, defeated the evil god and brought peace.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9c18: "What's painted in this mural is the sacred giant dragon, lord of the Skyfolk.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9cbc: "In prehistoric times, the sacred dragon is said to have led the Skyfolk here from infinitely far away.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9dec: "The sacred dragon is the progenitor of light and a great being. Did it truly look as painted here...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9f54: "The evil god Calasmos, born of the great darkness, is said to have come seeking the great power sleeping in Yggdrasil.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a054: "It's said he seeks the great tree's power to bring ruin to the world, but nothing is certain.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a138: "Either way, if Yggdrasil is lost, the flow of all life will end. We must avoid that at all costs.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a2d0: "Luminary and evil god are two sides of one coin. You were sent by Yggdrasil to defeat the evil god.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a3a8: "Only you can defeat the evil god. Please defeat Calasmos and restore peace to Erdrea.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a4e0: "I learned from old texts that the Tower of Oblivion quietly keeps time somewhere in this world.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a5c0: "They say spirits weaving the flow of endless time, avatars of lost time, gather there.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a69c: "Fascinating, isn't it? As a Skyfolk scholar, I'd love to visit that tower once.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a7d8: "The six orbs imbued with Yggdrasil's power were made by our ancestors.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a884: "One theory says they're crystallized nectar overflowing from life's source, the great tree's soul. Nothing is certain.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a97c: "Anyway, they're surely precious items made with lost ancient technology.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aaac: "Luminary, we meet at last. We Skyfolk have long awaited you, who carry Erdwin's name.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|abdc: "I've loved casinos since long ago. Now and then I disguise myself as a human and visit Puerto Valor's casino.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|adbc: "I've loved casinos since long ago. Now and then I disguise myself as a human and visit Puerto Valor's casino.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ac90: "I especially like the slots and keep at it until I win. I understand how people get hooked.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ae70: "I especially like the slots and keep at it until I win. I understand how people get hooked.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b000: "The Elder normally sleeps deeply with age. He's awake now for the first time in decades.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b0d0: "We're delighted that you, Luminary, can hear the words of an Elder who knew the legendary Luminary.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b1fc: "Don't worry. No matter what monster attacks, I'll protect you with my life.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b2f0: "Sitting at the table with my beloved is simply the best. I wish these happy days would last forever...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b494: "The four statues in this plaza were made in ancient times to honor Erdwin and his companions.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b584: "Please take a look at the faces of the legendary heroes.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b640: "This is the statue of the legendary Luminary, Erdwin. Though your face differs, {var:1}, you have the same brave eyes.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b784: "Ouranos the mage was born into a noble family and raised without want.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b840: "He also mastered countless spells as a child and was praised as the world's greatest mage.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b938: "Strange, isn't it... To me, he who was so blessed seems to have sad eyes.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ba5c: "Erdwin the Luminary fell in love at first sight of Senya the sage.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bae8: "Seeing her statue there, even I am captivated by her beauty. I understand the Luminary's love.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bc3c: "Ouranos was drawn to the evil god's power and betrayed Erdwin. But why, when he was so blessed...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bcfc: "No, it's useless to wonder. Only Ouranos knows. He must have had his own torment.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|be8c: "Squeak! Don't be scared! I'm no bad monster. I'm a migrating Dracky who moves around with the seasons.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bf4c: "This village is perfect for resting on the way, so my wife and I are staying here.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c044: "Squeak! When I was flying for a change of pace, I saw a pitch-black sun over Gallopolis.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c21c: "Squeak! When I was flying for a change of pace, I saw a pitch-black sun over Gallopolis.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c118: "It ruined Gallopolis's beautiful scenery and I felt terrible. I wish someone would do something...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c2f0: "It ruined Gallopolis's beautiful scenery and I felt terrible. I wish someone would do something...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c3d8: "What, you mean to destroy that black sun? You're a good person. I'm cheering for you.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c55c: "Squeak! Amazing! They sell so many stylish items you can't find in the monster world!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c6f8: "Squeak! Amazing! They sell so many stylish items you can't find in the monster world!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c604: "Maybe I'll buy a souvenir for my uncle on the surface. But I can't decide what to buy.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c7a0: "Look at this! This pot is great! I've never seen such a stylish pot! I'll make hubby buy it!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c8a8: "Squeak! The air and water here are clean and the people kind, so it's a nice place to live.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cc44: "Squeak! The air and water here are clean and the people kind, so it's a nice place to live.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c954: "We migrating Drackies must move on someday, but I'll miss the Skyfolk...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ccf0: "We migrating Drackies must move on someday, but I'll miss the Skyfolk...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ca7c: "Squeak! They sell so many stylish items that I got carried away and bought too much!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cb24: "I even spent the savings for our coming baby, and hubby will be furious! What do I do! Squeak!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ce8c: "Surprised to see monsters in the Skyfolk village? There are all kinds, and not all are bad.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cf70: "Even if they look scary, some are surprisingly friendly.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d054: "After the battle with the evil god, the warrior Nelsen founded the Kingdom of Bandelphon to rebuild the ravaged world.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d148: "Legend says he hid the mighty arms used against the evil god in that kingdom, but monsters destroyed it.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d264: "Now I wonder if monsters attacked that kingdom to destroy those arms...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d374: "Nelsen the warrior spoke little, yet got along with the Skyfolk. They understood each other by heart.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d458: "Nelsen had Skyfolk who served as his squires, and after the battle they descended to the surface with him.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d554: "Human Nelsen has surely died, but the Skyfolk who served him may still be alive somewhere on the surface.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d6f4: "The black sun has appeared again... The great calamity of legend has finally revived.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d7c0: "But even if we wanted to fight like our ancestors, we've lost our power over the long ages and can do nothing...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d8c8: "They say that evil god has revived. This village might be attacked someday. What will become of us...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d9b4: "He loves the buns I make. Seeing him enjoy them so much makes all my effort worthwhile.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|db48: "I collect animals for scholarly research. Surface animals, rarely seen by Skyfolk, are fascinating subjects.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dde0: "I collect animals for scholarly research. Surface animals, rarely seen by Skyfolk, are fascinating subjects.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e214: "I collect animals for scholarly research. Surface animals, rarely seen by Skyfolk, are fascinating subjects.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dc88: "This large animal called a horse especially is said to carry humans on its back at a run. A rewarding subject.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|df18: "By the way, I hear that in the human world there are races where people ride horses and compete for speed. Is that true?
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dff4: "I see. Such a fun event exists. I'd like to ride this horse in a race someday.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e0f4: "I see. That's a pity. I wanted to ride this horse in a race someday.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e354: "I'm not good with this chicken, though. It always chases me, clucking, and pecks me with its beak.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e4bc: "Whoa! A real human! Amazing! My first time seeing one! So this is what humans look like!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e5ac: "...Why so surprised? Living in this village, I rarely get to see humans.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e660: "To us, humans are almost legendary creatures. Of course I'm surprised.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e760: "I'm eighty-eight this year. Skyfolk become adults at one hundred, so I'll join the adults soon.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e88c: "Luminary, you're already an adult. I envy how fast humans grow up. ...Ah, I want to be an adult soon.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ea28: "Believe it or not, I was famous as a villainous slime who chased poor children around.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ec0c: "Believe it or not, I was famous as a villainous slime who chased poor children around.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ead0: "But after coming to the Skyfolk village, the sacred air here changed me. I became a good monster...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ecb4: "But after coming to the Skyfolk village, the sacred ember purified my evil power. I became a good monster...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ef6c: "The beds here are unusually shaped, but humans sleep soundly in them too, so rest easy.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f0dc: "In the human world and the Skyfolk world, gold talks all the same. Deposit your money properly!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f270: "Your battles will only grow fiercer. Pray often.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f3bc: "The goods here are made by Skyfolk with great skill. They'll be useful, so buy some.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f524: "This Temple of the Sun enshrines the sacred ember we Skyfolk have guarded since Erdrea's creation.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f614: "Examine the sacred ember deep in the temple and you may find clues to the power that dispels darkness.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f75c: "The last Luminary carried the sacred ember around the world to forge a sword that dispels darkness.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f894: "If you follow his footsteps, you'll surely reach your goal. ...Want to review what you must do?
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f9cc: "To forge the sword you need ore and a smith's hammer. You strike the sword at a special forge.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fad0: "The previous Luminary probably got the ore at the Battleground in the Sky, another floating island like this one.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fbd0: "You can get the hammer in Gallopolis.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fc38: "Last is the summit of the great volcano visible from Hotto. They say he finished the sword at a special forge there.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fd70: "If you forget what to do, come see me anytime. ...Everyone, do your best!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fe8c: "You did it! You forged a new Luminary's sword.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ff04: "Mordegon should be deep in that ominous castle floating in the sky. ...The final battle is near.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ffd4: "Please do your best! All life in Erdrea is cheering for you.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|100b: "The Dark One is defeated and Yggdrasil is revived... The great flow of life will return to Erdrea.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|101a: "Those who died will be reborn as new life under the great tree's leaves. ...Thank you, Luminary {var:1}!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1031: "I'm a harp maker in the Skyfolk village. I study how to make harps with beautiful tones every day.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1050: "Serena's harp seems to have a beautiful tone. As a harp maker, I can tell.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|105b: "Legend says Senya's harp had healing power, and its sound soothed Luminaries weary from battle.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|106b: "The strings of her harp, made by the Skyfolk, used mystic amethyst, an ore filled with special magic.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|107c: "The harp-making method has been handed down, but the mystic amethyst is gone, so I can't make it.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|108c: "Ah, if only I had it, I could restring Serena's harp and boost its healing power.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1097: "Hey, Luminary! Would you get mystic amethyst for me? I'm sure you can.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10ac: "...I see. You're busy, Luminary. Ah, with that amethyst I could have recreated Senya's harp.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10c1: "Really?! Thanks! The Amethyst Worm at the bottom of the Battleground in the Sky has it.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10ce: "But you need the Last Key to enter the Amethyst Worm's lair, so be careful. The key is in the Elder's plaza.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10f4: "But you need the Last Key to enter the Amethyst Worm's lair, so be careful. The key is in the Elder's plaza.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10d9: "When you get the mystic amethyst, bring it to me.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10ff: "When you get the mystic amethyst, bring it to me.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10e9: "The Amethyst Worm at the bottom of the Battleground in the Sky has the mystic amethyst.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|110b: "Hello, Luminary. If you came to me, did you get the mystic amethyst?
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1118: "Oh, no... too bad. I thought I could recreate Senya's harp.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1136: "So this is mystic amethyst. Ah... what a beautiful ore. I feel such mystic power.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1141: "With this, I can recreate Senya's harp with the healing power told in legend.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|114d: "Then it's time to show my skill! I'll string Serena's harp with amethyst strings right away!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1158:
The Skyfolk harp maker turned

and restrung Serena's harp.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1165: "Thanks for waiting! It's done! I shouldn't say so myself, but it's superb!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|116f: "When Serena plays this harp, the tone will be more beautiful than ever. Here, take it!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|117c:
The harp's healing power rose!
Serena's healing magic went up by 100!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1185: "Recreating the harp Senya used taught me so much as a harp maker. Thank you!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11a4: "Recreating the harp Senya used taught me so much as a harp maker. Thank you!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1199: "Hello, Luminary. Serena's harp sounds more beautiful than ever now, doesn't it?

id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11d7: "Erdwin the legendary Luminary and Senya the sage were reportedly lovers.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11ff: "Erdwin the legendary Luminary and Senya the sage were reportedly lovers.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11e3: "Looking at the statues there, the two look alike. They seem a perfect couple.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|120b: "They wore matching bangles and vowed eternal love, but it ended without them being united.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1216: "Loving each other yet torn apart... a truly tragic story.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1220: "So I thought: how about putting matching bangles on their statues?
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1229: "They can never meet again, but I want to fulfill their feelings at least.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1231: "But Erdwin's bangle was lost in the endless ages and I don't have it.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|123a: "So here's my request, Luminary: find Erdwin's bangle and bring it to me?
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|124f: "...I see. You must defeat the evil god, so you have no time for that.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1258: "Even if only a comfort, I want them united. I'll do something about it.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|126c: "Wow, I'm so happy! As expected of the Luminary, you're kind!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1272: "I don't know where the bangle is, but I heard Nelsen the warrior inherited Erdwin's belongings after his death.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12a0: "I don't know where the bangle is, but I heard Nelsen the warrior inherited Erdwin's belongings after his death.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1280: "Nelsen founded Bandelphon, whose underground labyrinth holds many treasures. Maybe it's there...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ad: "Nelsen founded Bandelphon, whose underground labyrinth holds many treasures. Maybe it's there...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|128f: "When you get Erdwin's bangle, bring it here. I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12bc: "When you get Erdwin's bangle, bring it here. I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ca: "Luminary, I was getting tired of waiting. Did you finally get Erdwin's bangle?
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12d5: "Oh, I jumped to conclusions. Ah, I want to put the bangle on the statue soon and comfort their hearts.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12f7: "This is Erdwin's bangle! It matches Senya's that I have.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ff: "Now their feelings will be rewarded. Thank you, Luminary. Erdwin and Senya will surely be glad...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|130d:

and shine brightly!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1313:

id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1325: "Receiving the bangles' light, the Luminary awakened to new power...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|132f: "Amazing! Surely Erdwin and Senya answered the Luminary's feelings!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1337: "The legendary Luminary Erdwin's power passed to you, the current Luminary. It can only be a miracle...
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1346: "What a warm light. Even across endless ages, their love is still red-hot, I guess... Eek!
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1351: "That their feelings were rewarded is all thanks to you, Luminary. Thank you so much.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1362: "Thank you for finding the bangle. Don't worry. I'll put their bangles on the statues later.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|136e: "Seeing them now, they're truly a perfect couple.
id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1374: "Ah, I wish a prince on a white horse as dashing as Erdwin would appear before me someday...

id./param/region/r020.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13a4: "If you could inherit the power they left, ordinary monsters would be nothing to fear.

tm.「聖なる種火には 我らの神のチカラが宿ります。\n それを持っていれば 地上にあ: "The sacred ember holds our god's power. With it, you can read the great tree's memories from saplings on the surface.
tm.「神の民には 地上にくわしい者も多いので\n ３本あると伝えられる 苗木の場所は: "Many Skyfolk know the surface well. Ask the villagers where the three saplings are said to be.
tm.「以前 神秘の歯車を使えば\n 時を刻む 忘却の塔の扉を開くことができると\n: "I once heard from Igortap that a mystic gear can open the door of the Tower of Oblivion, which keeps time.
tm.「たしか 壁画に描かれた塔は\n 命の大樹の北 山々に囲まれた場所にあるはず。\: "The tower in the mural should stand north of Yggdrasil, ringed by mountains. Ride Cetacea there.
tm.「神の使い ケトスが\n 新たなチカラに 目覚めたようですね。\n その翼が あ: "Cetacea, the divine messenger, seems to have awakened to new power. Its wings will guide you.
tm.「もう 何も おそれることはありません。\n ケトスに乗って 黒い太陽に向かい\: "You have nothing left to fear. Ride Cetacea to the black sun and defeat the evil god Calasmos.
tm.「苗木が すべてを知っている……。\n クーロンさまは この言葉に\n 心当たり: "The saplings know everything... Koron seems to know what that means.
tm.「クーロンさまは 里の中央の浮島にある\n 太陽の神殿で 勇者の兄ちゃんを待って: "Koron is waiting for you, Luminary, at the Temple of the Sun on the village's central floating island.
tm.「聖なる苗木は 標高が高い場所にあると聞くよ。\n 苗木を探すなら クジラに乗っ: "They say sacred saplings grow at high altitude. To find one, ride the whale around the world.
tm.「オイラの一族は 昔から\n ずっと 聖なる苗木の世話をしてるんだ。: "My clan has long tended the sacred saplings.
tm.「大樹の意思を伝える 神聖な木の世話は\n 責任が重くて たいへんな仕事だけど\: "Tending the holy tree that conveys the great tree's will is a heavy duty, but I'm proud of it.
tm.「この前 不思議な夢を見たんだ。\n 神の民の里が 魔物たちに襲われて\n 太陽: "I had a strange dream. The Skyfolk village was attacked by monsters, and only I survived in the Temple of the Sun.
tm.「ひとりぼっちになった オイラは\n 神殿で 勇者の兄ちゃんに会ったんだけど……: "Alone, I met you, Luminary, in the temple...
tm.「カオも見たことのない 勇者の兄ちゃんが\n なんで 夢に出てきたんだろ？\n: "Why did a Luminary whose face I've never seen appear in my dream? ...A truly strange dream.
tm.「勇者さま ようこそ いらっしゃいました。\n ここは いにしえの昔より\n 命: "Welcome, Luminary. This is the village of the Skyfolk, a clan that has served Yggdrasil since ancient times.
